name: gorilla-agent-hono-api
description: Serverless Hono API with Gemini agent orchestration and MCP connectivity for the MongoDB track

scripts.deploy: tsc && gcloud run deploy gorilla-agent-api --source . --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated
scripts.test:smoke: node -e "const test = async () => { const base = 'http://localhost:8080'; console.log('=== Health Check ==='); const h = await fetch(base+'/health'); console.log(await h.json()); console.log('=== Generate Suite ==='); const g = await fetch(base+'/api/v1/generate', {method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({prompt:'Create a TypeScript coding test for mid-level full-stack engineers',roleContext:'fullstack-typescript',problemCount:2,difficultyMix:{beginner:0.2,intermediate:0.5,advanced:0.3}})}); console.log(JSON.stringify(await g.json(),null,2).substring(0,500)+'... [truncated]'); console.log('=== Guardian Ingest ==='); const i = await fetch(base+'/api/v1/guardian/ingest', {method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({events:[{eventId:'evt-001',sessionId:'ses-001',candidateId:'can-001',assessmentId:'asmt-001',problemId:'prob-001',eventType:'PASTE_TRIGGER',timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),payload:{pasteContent:'function foo() { return 42; }',deltaMs:120},clientMetadata:{userAgent:'test-agent',ipAddress:'127.0.0.1',screenResolution:'1920x1080',platform:'web',language:'en-US'}}]})}); console.log(await i.json()); console.log('=== Session Review ==='); const r = await fetch(base+'/api/v1/sessions/ses-001'); console.log(await r.json()); console.log('\\n=== ALL SMOKE TESTS PASSED ===');}; test().catch(e => {console.error('SMOKE TEST FAILED:',e.message); process.exit(1);});"
